name: Boolean upward-closure suppression
claim: Blind modes of zeta incidence convolution read only seed coefficients on the upward closure of their negative-prime sets.

label: T133.2
name: Omega-tail bound
claim: For blind family B, ||Pi_B Zb||/||Zb|| is bounded by the normalized zeta-convolved tail of b on upward(B).

label: T133.3
name: HS block import
claim: Heap--Soundararajan Omega-block architecture supplies a non-smuggled template for declaring prime-block cutoffs K_j and high-Omega truncations.

label: T133.4
name: Restricted BPRZ salvage
claim: If blind overlap is at most delta<1 and K_q has lower bound gamma on nonblind class, then the restricted lower frame has strength gamma(1-delta^2).
